title: Helsinki Grotesk Pro / Light and Light Italic
slide_intent: Judge light and light italic in real words and paragraphs so weight and slant can be chosen for both voice and reading.
strategic_value: The light and light italic specimens can help Helsinki retain a consistent family while selecting an appropriate degree of emphasis.
demonstration: A two-column specimen combines Ukrainian and other Cyrillic specimens, a Ukrainian paragraph and oversized Cyrillic words.
practical_value: Compare the light and light italic cuts at display and paragraph scale before assigning them to a communication.

content_islands.name: Word specimens
content_islands.spec: Large words demonstrate the selected upright and italic cuts.

content_islands.name: Paragraph and large forms
content_islands.spec: A smaller paragraph and oversized letter or numeral forms provide contrasting reading scales.
